title: Syringaresinol alleviates IgG immune complex induced acute lung injury via activating PPARgamma and suppressing pyroptosis.
authors: Zhang, Sijia; Yang, Lei; Hu, Dongsheng; He, Siqi; Cui, Lingzhi; Zhao, Jiuling; Zhuo, Yuzhen; Zhang, Lanqiu; Wang, Ximo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物SYG通过激活PPARgamma抑制IgG免疫复合物诱导的急性肺损伤，虽含分子对接但核心是炎症与焦亡机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a life-threatening condition characterized by severe lung inflammation and tissue damage. In this study, we investigate the potential therapeutic efficacy of (+)-Syringaresinol (SYG), a natural compound known for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, in alleviating ALI induced by IgG immune complexes (IgG-IC). Using MH-S cells as a model, we explore SYG's ability to target peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) and its anti-inflammatory properties. Our comprehensive investigation aims to elucidate the specific molecular mechanisms underlying SYG's effects against pyroptosis, as revealed through transcriptomic analysis. Validation in C57BL/6 mice provides in vivo support. Our findings indicate that SYG effectively mitigates IgG-IC-induced lung damage, as evidenced by a significant reduction in lung inflammation and tissue injury. SYG treatment notably decreases pro-inflammatory cytokine levels (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta) in both lung tissue and cells. Molecular docking analysis reveals SYG's robust binding to PPARgamma, leading to the inhibition of IgG-IC-induced inflammatory signaling pathways. Additionally, transcriptomic analysis unveils SYG's potential in suppressing macrophage pyroptosis, potentially through the downregulation of key inflammatory mediators (NLRP3, GSDMD, Caspase-1). In summary, our study presents compelling evidence supporting SYG as an effective therapeutic agent for ALI. SYG's activation of PPARgamma contributes to the suppression of NF-kappaB and C/EBPs expression, thereby mitigating inflammation. Moreover, SYG demonstrates the ability to inhibit macrophage pyroptosis by targeting the NLRP3/GSDMD/caspase-1 axis.
abstract_zh: 急性肺损伤（ALI）是一种危及生命的疾病，其特征为严重的肺部炎症和组织损伤。在本研究中，我们探讨了天然化合物(+)-Syringaresinol（SYG）在缓解由IgG免疫复合物（IgG-IC）诱导的ALI方面的潜在治疗功效，该化合物以其抗氧化和抗炎特性而闻名。以MH-S细胞为模型，我们研究了SYG靶向过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）的能力及其抗炎特性。我们的综合研究旨在阐明SYG对抗细胞焦亡的具体分子机制，这一机制通过转录组分析得以揭示。在C57BL/6小鼠中的验证提供了体内支持。我们的研究结果表明，SYG能有效减轻IgG-IC诱导的肺损伤，这体现在肺部炎症和组织损伤的显著减少上。SYG治疗显著降低了肺组织和细胞中促炎细胞因子水平（TNF-alpha、IL-6、IL-1beta）。分子对接分析显示，SYG与PPARgamma具有强结合能力，从而抑制IgG-IC诱导的炎症信号通路。此外，转录组分析揭示了SYG在抑制巨噬细胞焦亡方面的潜力，可能通过下调关键炎症介质（NLRP3、GSDMD、Caspase-1）实现。总之，我们的研究提供了有力证据，支持SYG作为ALI的有效治疗药物。SYG对PPARgamma的激活有助于抑制NF-kappaB和C/EBPs的表达，从而减轻炎症。此外，SYG显示出通过靶向NLRP3/GSDMD/caspase-1轴来抑制巨噬细胞焦亡的能力。
